paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Corse Front Splitter is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, the Corse splitter is the most aggressive front aerodynamic component currently in Alpha-N's G87 motorsport program — engineered using CAD modelling, CFD airflow simulation, and real-world track testing to deliver measurable aerodynamic performance.

Unlike traditional front lips that primarily alter appearance, the Corse splitter extends significantly underneath the front bumper to generate real aerodynamic load. The extended splitter surface creates a pressure differential between the upper and lower airflow zones — high-pressure air builds on top while accelerated airflow moves beneath, pushing the front of the vehicle toward the pavement. The result is increased front-end downforce, improved grip, sharper steering response, and greater high-speed stability.
